items.exampleEn: What is on the agenda for today's meeting?
items.exampleZh: 今天會議的議程有哪些？

items.exampleEn: Negotiation is an important skill in business.
items.exampleZh: 協商是商業上很重要的技能。

items.exampleEn: Nobody noticed his absence from the party.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人注意到他沒來派對。

items.exampleEn: The two teams negotiated for hours.
items.exampleZh: 兩隊協商了好幾個小時。

items.exampleEn: She has a paid job at the library.
items.exampleZh: 她在圖書館有一份支薪的工作。

items.exampleEn: Please join the queue and wait your turn.
Too much phone time often leads to procrastination.
items.exampleZh: 花太多時間在手機上常常會導致拖延。

items.exampleEn: The noticeboard is next to the front door.

items.sentenceEn: The agenda for tomorrow is very long.

items.audioEn: To take a paid day off in May, add your name to the list on the noticeboard.
items.audioZh: 如果你想在五月請一天有薪假，請在公告欄上的名單寫上你的名字。
items.questionZh: 想在五月請有薪假要怎麼做？
options: Write your name on a form
Send an email to the manager's office
Talk to the manager before the end of April
Add your name to the noticeboard

items.sentenceEn: Her long absence worried her friends.
items.sentenceZh: 她長時間不在讓朋友們很擔心。

items.sentenceEn: Is this a paid course, or is it free?
items.sentenceZh: 這是付費課程還是免費的？

items.stemEn: Please don't jump the ____; everyone is waiting.
items.stemZh: 請不要插隊，大家都在等。

items.stemEn: The workers want to ____ shorter hours with their boss.
items.stemZh: 工人們想和老闆協商縮短工時。

items.passageEn: Here is what happened at today's staff meeting. The first item on the agenda was the negotiation with the company that sells us paper. The manager explained how she negotiated a lower price. Then she talked about paid holidays: from next year, all staff will get fifteen paid days off. She also asked everyone to add any planned absence to the list on the noticeboard. Finally, she joked about procrastination: "Please don't wait until Friday to finish Monday's work!" After the meeting, there was a long queue at the coffee machine.
items.passageZh: 以下是今天員工會議的情形。議程的第一項是和賣紙給我們的公司協商。經理說明了她怎麼談到更低的價格。接著她談到有薪假：從明年起，所有員工都有十五天有薪假。她也請大家把預定的請假加到公告欄上的清單裡。最後，她拿拖延開玩笑：「請不要等到星期五才完成星期一的工作！」會後，咖啡機前面大排長龍。

questions.questionZh: 經理和賣紙的公司談了什麼？

items.promptZh: 拖延讓我很晚才完成作業。
referenceEn: I finished my homework very late because of procrastination.
Because of procrastination, I finished my homework very late.
rubricZh: procrastination 表示「拖延」，是不可數名詞，例如 because of procrastination 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 考試成績會貼在公告欄上。
referenceEn: The exam results will be put up on the noticeboard.
The test results will be posted on the noticeboard.
rubricZh: 用 noticeboard 表示「公告欄」（寫 notice board、bulletin board 也正確）
「貼」可寫，例如 put up、posted 等
